lines.A2UI 是 Google 在 2025 年 12 月開源的協定，讓 AI Ag: A2UI is a protocol that Google open-sourced in December 2025. It lets an AI Agent reply not only with text but with an interface: the Agent sends JSON that describes components and data, and the front end draws it with its own pre-approved components. Because the Agent sends data, not code, it cannot run arbitrary programs; it can only pick from the front end's component list.

lines.四顆 Agent 的類型不同，第二層要換測法：對話型出題測回答；判斷型用已知答案: The four Agents are different types, so the second layer changes method: conversational AI is tested with questions; decision AI with cases that have known answers, for accuracy and consistency across groups; generative AI by sampling output against the source; scoring AI against human scores.
